AuditEvent.description: An audit event as stored by otoroshi: what an admin or the admin api did. Every kind of audit event adds its own fields to the ones described here: an `AdminApiEvent`, for instance, adds `user`, `apiKey`, `action`, `from`, `message` and `metadata`

@id.description: The unique id of the event: a snowflake id generated by the otoroshi instance that emitted it, a number written as a string that grows with time

@timestamp.description: When the event happened, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

@type.description: The family of the event, always `AuditEvent` here

@product.description: The name of the product that emitted the event, the `otoroshi.events.name` setting (`otoroshi` by default)

@serviceId.description: The id of the entity the event is about, `--` for the events of otoroshi itself

@service.description: The name of the entity the event is about, `Otoroshi` for the events of otoroshi itself

@env.description: The environment of the otoroshi instance (the `app.env` setting)

audit.description: The kind of the audit event, like `AdminApiEvent` (a call of the admin api), `BackOfficeEvent` (an action in the backoffice) or `SnowMonkeyOutageRegisteredEvent`

user-agent-details.description: What the user agent detection of the global configuration found about the user agent of the caller. `null` when it is disabled or found nothing

origin-details.description: What the geolocation of the global configuration found about the ip address of the caller. `null` when it is disabled or found nothing

instance-number.description: The number of the otoroshi instance that emitted the event (the `app.instance.number` setting)

instance-name.description: The name of the otoroshi instance that emitted the event

instance-zone.description: The zone of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.zone`)

instance-region.description: The region of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.region`)

instance-dc.description: The datacenter of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.datacenter`)

instance-provider.description: The provider of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.provider`)

instance-rack.description: The rack of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.rack`)

cluster-mode.description: The cluster mode of the otoroshi instance

cluster-name.description: The name of the otoroshi instance in its cluster, `none` when it is not part of a cluster

AlertEvent.description: An alert event as stored by otoroshi: something an admin should know about. Every kind of alert adds its own fields to the ones described here: an `AdminLoggedInAlert`, for instance, adds `user` and `from`

@id.description: The unique id of the event: a snowflake id generated by the otoroshi instance that emitted it, a number written as a string that grows with time

@timestamp.description: When the event happened, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

@type.description: The family of the event, always `AlertEvent` here

@product.description: The name of the product that emitted the event, the `otoroshi.events.name` setting (`otoroshi` by default)

@serviceId.description: The id of the entity the event is about, `--` for the events of otoroshi itself

@service.description: The name of the entity the event is about, `Otoroshi` for the events of otoroshi itself

@env.description: The environment of the otoroshi instance (the `app.env` setting)

alert.description: The kind of the alert, like `AdminLoggedInAlert`, `ApiKeyCreatedAlert`, `CircuitBreakerOpenedAlert` or `UserAnalyticsAlert`

user-agent-details.description: What the user agent detection of the global configuration found about the user agent of the caller. `null` when it is disabled or found nothing

origin-details.description: What the geolocation of the global configuration found about the ip address of the caller. `null` when it is disabled or found nothing

instance-number.description: The number of the otoroshi instance that emitted the event (the `app.instance.number` setting)

instance-name.description: The name of the otoroshi instance that emitted the event

instance-zone.description: The zone of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.zone`)

instance-region.description: The region of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.region`)

instance-dc.description: The datacenter of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.datacenter`)

instance-provider.description: The provider of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.provider`)

instance-rack.description: The rack of the otoroshi instance (`otoroshi.cluster.relay.location.rack`)

cluster-mode.description: The cluster mode of the otoroshi instance

cluster-name.description: The name of the otoroshi instance in its cluster, `none` when it is not part of a cluster

LiveStats.description: The live statistics of some traffic: the counters since the datastore holds them, and the rates and average durations of the latest calls. On a leader, the rates add up, and the durations average, the ones the members of the cluster report

calls.description: The total number of calls handled, counted in the datastore while `enableEmbeddedMetrics` of the global configuration is true

dataIn.description: The total number of bytes received from the clients, counted in the datastore while `enableEmbeddedMetrics` of the global configuration is true

dataOut.description: The total number of bytes sent back to the clients, counted in the datastore while `enableEmbeddedMetrics` of the global configuration is true

rate.description: The number of calls per second, over the latest calls

duration.description: The average duration of the latest calls, in milliseconds

overhead.description: The average time otoroshi itself spent on the latest calls (their duration without the time of the backend), in milliseconds

dataInRate.description: The bytes per second received from the clients, over the latest calls

dataOutRate.description: The bytes per second sent back to the clients, over the latest calls

concurrentHandledRequests.description: The number of requests being handled right now (by the whole cluster on a leader)

HostMetrics.description: The metrics of the jvm and of the host of the otoroshi instance that answers

cpu_usage.description: The cpu load of the otoroshi process, in percent

heap_used.description: The memory of the heap in use, in megabytes

heap_size.description: The memory of the heap the jvm holds, in megabytes

live_threads.description: The number of threads alive in the jvm, the daemon threads included

live_peak_threads.description: The highest number of live threads since the jvm started

daemon_threads.description: The number of daemon threads alive in the jvm, a part of `live_threads`

env.description: The `APP_ENV` environment variable, `--` when it is not set

commit_id.description: The `COMMIT_ID` environment variable, `--` when it is not set

instance_number.description: The `INSTANCE_NUMBER` environment variable, `--` when it is not set

app_id.description: The `APP_ID` environment variable, `--` when it is not set

instance_id.description: The `INSTANCE_ID` environment variable, `--` when it is not set

TrafficStats.description: The statistics of the traffic over a period, read from the Elasticsearch cluster of the global configuration (`elasticReadsConfig`)

type.description: What the statistics are filtered on: `Service` (a route), `ApiKey` or `Group`. Only answered by `GET /api/stats`

statusesPiechart.description: The number of calls of the period by http status code, as a pie chart

statusesHistogram.description: The calls by class of status code, over time

overheadPercentiles.description: The percentiles of the overhead of otoroshi, in milliseconds, over time

overheadStats.description: The count, min, max, average and standard deviation of the overhead of otoroshi, in milliseconds, over time

durationPercentiles.description: The percentiles of the duration of the calls, in milliseconds, over time

durationStats.description: The count, min, max, average and standard deviation of the duration of the calls, in milliseconds, over time

dataInStats.description: The statistics of the bytes received from the clients, over time

dataOutStats.description: The statistics of the bytes sent back to the clients, over time

hits.description: The number of calls of the period, counted by Elasticsearch

count.description: The number of gateway events of the period, one per call

dataIn.description: The total number of bytes received from the clients over the period, summed by Elasticsearch

data.dataIn.description: The value, `null` when no call matches

dataOut.description: The total number of bytes sent back to the clients over the period, summed by Elasticsearch

data.dataOut.description: The value, `null` when no call matches

avgDuration.description: The average duration of the calls, in milliseconds

duration.description: The value, `null` when no call matches

avgOverhead.description: The average overhead of otoroshi, in milliseconds

overhead.description: The value, `null` when no call matches

servicePiechart.description: The calls by route. Only answered for the whole traffic, an api key or a group

StatsPieChart.description: A pie chart of the traffic, read from Elasticsearch, in the shape the charts of the backoffice read

name.description: The name of the chart, always `Pie Chart`

colorPoint.description: Always `true`: each slice gets its own color

series.description: The series of the chart, always a single one holding the slices

name.description: What the slice counts (a status code, the name of a route), written as json: a name keeps its double quotes

y.description: The number of calls of the slice

StatsHistogram.description: A histogram of the traffic over time, read from Elasticsearch, in the shape the charts of the backoffice read

type.description: The kind of chart: `areaspline` for the statuses and the percentiles histograms, `chart` for the statistics histograms

series.description: The series of the histogram. A series is `null` when Elasticsearch answered no buckets

StatsHistogramSeries.description: A series of a histogram: a named curve, with a point per time bucket

name.description: The name of the series: a class of status codes (`1**` to `5**`) for the statuses histogram, `count`, `min`, `max`, `avg` or `std deviation` for a statistics histogram, a percentile (`1.0` to `99.0`) for a percentiles histogram

count.description: The number of calls of the series. Only in the statuses histogram

data.description: The points of the series, one per time bucket

StatsHistogramPoint.description: A point: the start of its time bucket (a unix timestamp in milliseconds), then its value. The value is `null` when the bucket holds no data

TrafficEvents.description: A page of the gateway events of the traffic, read from the Elasticsearch cluster of the global configuration (`elasticReadsConfig`)

type.description: What the events are filtered on: `Service` (a route), `ApiKey`, `Group`, or `None` for the whole traffic

events.description: The gateway events, in the order asked for

items.description: A `GatewayEvent`, as otoroshi sent it to Elasticsearch: the request, the route, the backend, the durations, the status...

ServiceStatus.description: The health of a route, day by day, read from the health check events of the Elasticsearch cluster of the global configuration

descriptor.description: The id of the route whose health is described, as found in the `@serviceId` of its health check events

kind.description: The kind of entity: `route`, `route_compositions` (a route of a route composition), or `service` by default

service.description: The name of the route, `UNKNOWN` when it is not found anymore

line.description: The environment of the route, `prod` by default

total.description: The number of health checks over the period

dates.description: The health checks, day by day

ServiceStatusDate.description: The health checks of a route on a day

date.description: The start of the day, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

dateAsString.description: The start of the day, as Elasticsearch writes it

total.description: The number of health checks of the day

status.description: The health checks of the day, by health

ServiceStatusHealth.description: The health checks of a route on a day that found the same health

health.description: The health the checks found: `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `RED` or `BLACK`

total.description: The number of health checks that found it

percentage.description: The share of the health checks of the day that found it, in percent
